Free Top Down Military Boats Pixel Art

Description

We present you a collection of sprites – Free Top Down Military Boats Pixel Art. This is a pixel art set that will suit any game developer with a military theme, such as a strategy game or a 2D shooter. Format: PSD, PNG.

Especially for you, the set includes:
  • Water tileset (32×32);
  • Animations of boats on the water;
  • Animations of shots from guns;
  • 3 different colors of boats (green, pixel, white pixel);
  • Exploded boats (broken);
  • Separate parts of broken boats in the files: water, part of the gun, blown up tower / hull, broken boat;
  • Separate parts of whole boats in files: hull, water, turret with a gun, shots from guns.

Thanks to this asset, you can diversify your game by adding new levels with different vehicles and make it look like a realistic battlefield with the help of broken boats assets and shot animations.

About Us

Hello! We are glad to present you our game asset online store, which provides graphics for creating video games. If you are creating your own games, our store boasts the highest quality 2D game assets you can buy online. By using this amazing resource, you will find Free and Premium game assets, GUI (graphical user interface), Tilesets (sets of textures and sprites for game levels), Character Sprites (characters in different variations, i.e. running, jumping, etc.), and Game Backgrounds suited to every fancy. Please, pay attention to the fact that we also offer you FREE game assets! Our goal is to provide you with the best game content for your projects.
